Body.Content:
When it's time to present what your team decided, you can ask Facilitator to create a PowerPoint presentation from what was said, chats, and shared files in the meeting. It turns the conversation into the slides, whether that's a project update, a proposal, or a readout for leadership. Facilitator can already draft documents in Word, so now your team can also go straight from discussion to a deck.

GA date: December CY2026
